visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of glistening, grilled satay skewers on a white rectangular plate, garnished with cucumber slices and white onions on a wooden table. Yellow text appears at the top. (2) Hands in translucent gloves massage raw chicken pieces in a clear glass bowl, adding paste-like seasonings. (3) Yellow powder, white sugar, and dark liquid are poured over the chicken in the bowl and mixed thoroughly by hand. (4) White thick cream is added to the marinated chicken and hand-mixed again. (5) In a dark pan, chopped red onions and garlic are stirred with a metal spoon over low heat. (6) Brown paste and powder are added to the pan and mixed into the sautéed aromatics. (7) White coconut milk is poured into the pan, and the sauce is stirred until it becomes a thick, bubbling orange-brown liquid. (8) Liquid seasoning and red powder are added to the thickening sauce. (9) Skewers of marinated chicken are placed in a hot pan with oil and flipped using yellow tongs until browned and cooked. (10) The finished skewers are brushed with the thick satay sauce and finally dipped into a small red bowl filled with more sauce.
